# Security policy

ForecastLab is a **portfolio project** designed to run **locally**. It ships with synthetic data only and needs no
accounts, API keys or cloud services.

## What this repository does and does not contain

* No credentials, tokens, API keys or connection strings — none are required to run the app.
* No real company, customer, product or personal data — the demo dataset is generated by code
  (`backend/synthetic_data_generator`, reproducible with `random_seed`).
* The local database (`database/*.duckdb`), `.env` files and key/certificate files are excluded by `.gitignore`.

## Safe-by-default runtime

* The API (`uvicorn`) listens on `127.0.0.1` by default, and `docker compose` publishes ports on `127.0.0.1` only,
  so the app is not reachable from other machines unless you change it on purpose.
* CORS is limited to the local frontend origins (`FORECASTLAB_CORS`).
* Uploads are limited by size (`FORECASTLAB_MAX_UPLOAD_MB`, default 50 MB) and type (`.xlsx`, `.csv`, `.parquet`)
  and are parsed server-side; files are never executed.
* The local LLM (Ollama) receives only aggregated, already-computed facts; a numeric grounding guard rejects any
  number the model invents.
* There is **no authentication** in this MVP — do not deploy it on a public server with real data. See
  [docs/security.md](docs/security.md) for the enterprise plan (Entra ID, RBAC, secrets management, audit logs).

## Using your own data

If you upload real company data, keep it local: do not commit it (put files outside the repository or under an
ignored folder) and do not expose the ports.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please open a GitHub issue **without** sensitive details and ask for a private channel, or contact the author via
[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/wallisonsampaio).
